description:
"Just do as I say."
A high school baseball prodigy meets a bottom-ranked high school baseball player?!
An unbelievable one-year journey into the professional league at lightning speed, and a heart-fluttering romance!

Sung Hee-young is a student at Chorok High School in Gangwon Province. She is the only daughter of Sung Eun-sik, the current manager of the Cheongsol Dragons and the greatest player in Korean baseball history. True to the saying "like father, like daughter," Hee-young has inherited her father's monstrous talent. Although she can spot even the slightest movements that ordinary people cannot see and see through the hidden potential of players, she herself has no interest in sports and leads the life of an ordinary student preparing for college entrance exams.
Then one day, Lee Min-seo, a member of the same school's baseball team who has eyes for her, keeps lingering in her mind. Lee Min-seo is a bench pitcher at the bottom of the rankings, even within Chorok High School, which is at the bottom of the high school baseball scene. This kind and unremarkable man keeps catching Hee-young's eye, and eventually, she even ends up catching Min-seo's pitches. Heeyoung pointed out Minseo's subtle, annoying movements just in case, but lo and behold, Minseo perfectly executed Heeyoung's instructions and became the winning pitcher in the school's intrasquad scrimmage. Heeyoung sees Minseo in a new light for thoroughly following her advice and decides to make him a professional player…!
